messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Order x-axis in facets
parts:
Hi,

I would like to order each of my 'facet-cells' individually by their y-
values, in descending order.

my sample code might produce the output visible in the jpeg. in such a
case, i would like to have the following order:
A: M2, M4, M1, M3
B: M3, M1, M2, M4
C: M1, M4, M3, M2
D: M4, M3, M2, M1

I can't seem to figure out how to sort each cell individually. Any
help appreciated.

code: https://gist.github.com/1072457
visual example: http://bit.ly/pJorAj

Best,
Thomas

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Order x-axis in facets
parts:
It's not currently possible - facets have to share the same ordering in scales.
Hadley
